content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Music online

This architecture allows digital creators to sell music directly to their audience while maintaining full control over their transactions. Unlike platforms like Gumroad, which charge up to 10% per sale, our solution utilizes NOWPayments, which only takes 0.5%. This significant cost difference means more revenue retained for creators. Understanding this architecture is crucial for artists who want to thrive in an increasingly digital marketplace, where traditional barriers can stifle growth and creativity.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, the architecture is built on reliable, free tools that are accessible to anyone. By using Cloudflare Workers and Google Apps Script for backend logic, combined with GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, you create a robust system for selling music. Order management is handled by Supabase or Google Sheets, ensuring you have complete control and ownership of your data. Payment processing through NOWPayments allows you to accept Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies seamlessly, ensuring instant payment verification without the overhead of conventional payment processors.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is designed specifically for digital creators in regions facing payment restrictions, such as Nigeria, Kenya, and Venezuela. Whether you're a musician, a software developer, or a content creator, your ability to monetize your work should not be limited by the payment infrastructure available to you. With this sovereign stack, you can sell music, templates, or software without the constant worry of payment failures or excessive fees. This architecture empowers you to retain more of your earnings and connect directly with your audience.
NOWPayments reduces transaction fees to just 0.5%.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Key components include GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend processes, and NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions. These elements work together to create a seamless experience for both creators and customers. By integrating these tools, you can automate the delivery of your digital products without relying on third-party platforms. This setup not only enhances efficiency but also ensures you're not subject to the whims of any single platform, giving you the sovereignty you need in your digital commerce efforts.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To start selling your music online, first, select the components you need for your sovereign stack. You can choose the Sovereign Starter Stack or the Edge Commerce Stack based on your requirements. After deployment, upload your music files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for delivery. Set up payment processing with NOWPayments to accept Bitcoin, ensuring you can convert prices in USD at the time of transaction. Finally, promote your store link and enjoy the revenue retention that comes with lower fees compared to traditional platforms.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, consider using a combination of free hosting and automated payment solutions. Platforms like NOWPayments allow you to accept cryptocurrency payments directly, eliminating the need for conventional processors. This way, you retain more of your profits while maintaining full control of your sales.
With full data ownership, you control your sales and customer relationships.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking to expand your digital product offerings, consider our Complete Builder Kit, which includes all six blueprints and seven templates. This comprehensive package will equip you to build, deploy, and scale your sovereign digital commerce stack. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to learn more.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions
How can I accept Bitcoin for my digital downloads?

To accept Bitcoin, integrate NOWPayments into your digital commerce stack. This service allows you to process payments automatically and confirms transactions on-chain, making it easy to manage payments without relying on traditional payment platforms.
What are the costs associated with using this architecture?

The primary cost comes from NOWPayments, which charges a minimal fee of 0.5% on transactions. Compared to platforms like Gumroad that charge 10%, this architecture allows you to keep a much larger share of your sales revenue.
Can I automate product delivery?

Yes, by using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, you can automate the delivery of your digital products immediately after payment confirmation. This ensures a seamless experience for your customers without manual intervention.
Is my data secure with this setup?

Absolutely. This infrastructure is designed to give you full ownership of your data. You control the hosting, the payment processing, and the order management, ensuring that your information remains secure and private.
What types of digital products can I sell with this stack?

You can sell a variety of digital products, including music, ebooks, templates, software, and more. This flexibility allows creators from different fields to monetize their work effectively without platform restrictions.
